name: @vectra/web
description: Vectra Web professional AI workspace companion with local/cloud models, pre-parsed PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX attachments, image inputs, GGUF llama.cpp runtime, false-refusal recovery, and downloadable generated documents/code files.

scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @vectra/local-runtime && npm run build -w @vectra/agent-core
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:tools && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build:core && npm run build:tools && node server/server.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run build:tools && node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none test/*.test.mjs test/*.test.cjs
